snippet.title: Dark Descent - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3210260/Dark_Descent/

Dark Descent is a 4 player multiplayer cooperative horror game where you and your friends venture into an old elevator, aiming to reach the deepest levels. However, the journey won't be without it's challenges.
